name: experiment.completed length_eq cap → spawn autoresearch-synthesize (stop)
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign autoresearch pack — iteration LOOP stop half. Fires on the RUN entity when the iteration counter reaches the cap. Stamps autoresearch.stop.reason=cap and autoresearch.run.status=stopped on the run entity, and spawns autoresearch-synthesize to roll up the final artifact. Mutually exclusive with rule 05 (continue) — exactly one of the two fires per counter change.

Status flip is defense-in-depth: rule 05's condition on autoresearch.run.status=active means once 06 flips the status, any belated counter-change cannot re-spawn propose loops. (Under normal flow this is impossible — the counter only increments once per execute, and once length_eq cap fires there are no more execute spawns. But under transient redelivery or future parallel-execute variants the status guard is the safety belt.)

on_enter.subject: agent.task.autoresearch-synthesize
on_enter.prompt:
AUTORESEARCH SYNTHESIZE — final rollup.

The iteration loop has terminated: $entity.triple.autoresearch.experiment.completed.length iterations completed against cap $entity.triple.autoresearch.cap. Stop reason: cap reached.

Your job is to produce ONE artifact summarising the run: the baseline, the running-best, the kept improvements (with their diffs), the journey, and any open opportunities the journal suggests.

Iteration 1 — read the run entity context via prompt substitutions:

- command: $entity.triple.autoresearch.command
- surface: $entity.triple.autoresearch.surface
- baseline.value: $entity.triple.autoresearch.baseline.value
- best.value: $entity.triple.autoresearch.best.value
- best.experiment_id: $entity.triple.autoresearch.best.experiment_id

Iteration 2 — read the per-iteration journal. The JSON array of completed execute loop IDs is inlined as $entity.triple.autoresearch.experiment.completed.triples (ADR-048 .triples substitution). Parse the array; for each ID, call read_loop_result to read that iteration's terminal reason (carries: hypothesis, value, pass, outcome). Build a chronological narrative: which hypotheses were kept, which reverted, which crashed. The kept set is the substantive improvement story; the reverted set is the negative-result evidence.

Iteration 3 — read the best experiment's diff if best.experiment_id is not 'baseline'. bash: `git log --oneline -1 <best.experiment_id>` and `git show <best.experiment_id>` give you the diff committed by the best propose. If no commits exist (the pack does not commit per-iteration by default; iterations apply diffs in-tree and either kept-and-stay or reverted), the best state is the current working tree, and `git diff` against baseline_revision (look for a baseline-tag commit) yields the cumulative diff.

Iteration 4 — call emit_autoresearch_artifact with the structured rollup:

```
emit_autoresearch_artifact(
  title="<short descriptive — e.g. 'task test:integration wallclock reduction'>",
  command=<from run state>,
  baseline_value=<from run state>,
  best_value=<from run state>,
  improvement_pct=<(baseline - best) / baseline * 100>,
  cap=<from run state>,
  iterations_completed=<journal length>,
  iterations_kept=<count of outcome=kept>,
  iterations_reverted=<count of outcome=reverted>,
  iterations_crashed=<count of outcome=crashed>,
  best_diff_summary="<one-paragraph summary of what the best diff changed>",
  journey=[
    { iteration: 1, hypothesis: "<verbatim from propose.reason>", value: <number>, outcome: "<kept|reverted|crashed>" },
    ...
  ],
  open_opportunities="<one-paragraph — what the journal suggests has headroom but this run did not explore (next-run target)>"
)
```

The tool stamps autoresearch.artifact.{title, path, revision} on YOUR synthesize loop entity and renders a markdown view at /artifacts/autoresearch/<slug>.md. Then call decide(action="emit", reason="<one-line summary referencing the artifact slug + the improvement percentage>") per the autoresearch-synthesize/30-emit-artifact contract. Rule 07 fires on this and spawns reviewer-autoresearch.

If the run produced no kept iterations (best.value == baseline.value), still emit the artifact — the negative-result rollup is the deliverable, with open_opportunities carrying the substance of why the surface was not productive. Reviewer-autoresearch grades structural completeness, not improvement magnitude.

Per ADR-041 addendum 2026-05-15: chain agents do not query the graph. Bash + read_loop_result + the .triples substitution are your only read channels.

metadata.future_stop_reasons: plateau-N, time_budget, $_budget — all deferred to v2+; pack README §Open substrate questions #1 lists the substrate primitives they need.
metadata.mutually_exclusive_with_continue: Both rules 05 and 06 subscribe to the run entity on counter change. Rule 05 fires when length_lt cap; rule 06 fires when length_eq cap. Exactly one fires per counter increment.
metadata.status_flip_defense_in_depth: The autoresearch.run.status=stopped stamp ensures rule 05 cannot re-fire on belated counter changes (transient redelivery, future parallel-execute variants). Under the v1 single-thread iteration shape this is impossible to trigger; the guard is for forward safety.
